purpose: Select one finite, economically interpretable Campaign084 historical-only combination from the complete frozen 115-definition research library before reading any Campaign084 source row, candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return.

finite_candidate_design_catalog.reason: The fixed minimum of current profit-growth rank and same-fiscal-quarter profit-growth acceleration rank is high only when disclosed earnings growth is both strong and improving. It combines exactly two pre-existing definitions, binds the complete 115-definition library, and introduces no fitted coefficient, threshold, window, subset, or model.

A local turning-point or reversal count reopens the terminal close-return reversal, sign-run, directional-continuity, and weak-order sequence families rather than posing an independent economic question.
Subtracting volume and amount clock centers remains a transaction-price/activity-timing decomposition of terminal amount center-of-mass, profile-timing, and transaction-price mechanisms.
A full-session signed return would be a window change of the terminal late-return and signed close-path families, so neither momentum nor reversal direction is opened.
quality_profit and profit_yoy_acceleration already exist in the complete historical library and cannot be rerun as new standalone candidates.
Opening several agreement operators would add avoidable multiplicity. The sole selected weakest-link operator is the exact minimum.
The two inputs have different empirical scales and a raw or mixed-scale combination would add arbitrary normalization choices. Both components use the already frozen average-tie percentile semantics.
Adding a third component, event-age filter, minute factor, board, year, size, or market-regime condition would expand the search space without a single preselected mechanism.

selected_candidate.name: quarterly_profit_growth_level_acceleration_floor_2r
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: An already-public profit-growth state that ranks highly both in current level and in same-fiscal-quarter year-over-year acceleration represents strong and improving earnings momentum; the weakest-link construction avoids rewarding a high level that is decelerating or an acceleration from a weak base, and the disclosure state may remain under-repriced over the next three sessions.
selected_candidate.formula: For each stock day, attach the latest separately available profit_yoy level and profit_yoy_acceleration states from reports effective strictly before the signal. On the exact common finite two-state cross-section compute average-tie percentile ranks r_profit_level and r_profit_acceleration, then return min(r_profit_level,r_profit_acceleration).
selected_candidate.same_fiscal_quarter_rule: For each instrument and report month separately, profit_yoy_acceleration is the current report's finite profit_yoy minus the immediately prior report-year finite profit_yoy; Q1 compares with prior Q1, Q2 with prior Q2, Q3 with prior Q3, and annual Q4 with prior Q4.
selected_candidate.availability_rule: Both the current profit_yoy level and its acceleration become usable only on the first accepted local session strictly after the newer report's announcement_date.
selected_candidate.same_effective_date_rule: Sort by instrument, effective session, report_date, and announcement_date, then keep the last report per instrument and effective session.
selected_candidate.state_rule: Forward-fill profit_yoy and profit_yoy_acceleration independently inside each instrument after strict effective-session ordering; never backfill from a later disclosure.
selected_candidate.cross_section_rule: On each stock day require both states finite and compute pandas-compatible average-tie percentile ranks separately on that exact common two-state identity cross-section.
selected_candidate.combination_rule: Exactly min(r_profit_level,r_profit_acceleration); the operator and two unit weights implicit in the minimum are fixed and not fitted.
selected_candidate.missing_rule: Missing unless both already-effective states, both cross-sectional ranks, and the minimum are finite. Never impute, clip, winsorize, substitute, backfill, choose a favorable report, or reuse a later disclosure.

decision.next_action: Perform an exhaustive 115-definition semantic mechanism-overlap audit, then freeze one 113-comparator coverage-first no-return protocol before opening source or candidate values.
